mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pro.P_Name as pName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, dco.Dco_Major as dcoMajor, dco.Dco_Name as dcoName, dco.Dco_Code as dcoCode, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as dcbSupervisorName, c2.C_Name as dcbContractorName, mn.* from Con_Dc_Budget mn left join Con_Dco dco on dco.Dco_Id=mn.Dco_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Dcb_Supervisor_Id left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Dcb_Contractor_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Dcb_Id where mn.Dcb_Id=#{dcbId}
